name: my-channel
label: My Channel
description: Describe the channel in one line. Claude fills the rest from your brief.
tagline: One short line for the channel card in the app.
points: 3 to 5 short bullets for the card: what the videos are made of
one idea per bullet, a few words each
script_craft: auto — or "story" (someone else's story: documentary, history, mystery) / "teaching" (the viewer learns or gets a result) / "off" (only your own prompts)

voice.note: Pick a voice at go.algrow.online/tool and paste its id here. engine: elevenlabs (thousands of voices), stealth, or minimax (your own clones). List them with make_video.algrow_voices().

stock_queries: << Claude writes these from your niche >>

prompts.outline: << Claude writes this from your brief >>
prompts.script: << Claude writes this from your brief >>

thumbnail.brief: << Show Claude 5 thumbnails from your niche and it fills this in. Composition, palette, typography, recurring subject, what the face or object is doing, where the text sits. >>
thumbnail.note: Leave the brief empty and thumbnails still generate — they just follow the channel description instead of a proven layout.
